title: LibScript Component Manifest
description: Static metadata for a LibScript component

name.description: Unique identifier for the component (e.g. nodejs)

provides.description: Capabilities or aliases provided by this component

conflicts.description: Other components that conflict with this one

os_whitelist.description: List of operating systems supported by this component (or ['all'])

os_blacklist.description: List of operating systems explicitly unsupported by this component

arch_whitelist.description: List of CPU architectures supported by this component (or ['all'])

arch_blacklist.description: List of CPU architectures explicitly unsupported by this component

ports.description: Default ports used by the component

adapter_only.description: Indicates whether this component is an adapter/API-only wrapper that does not provide binary install/env lifecycles

category.description: Component classification group within the LibScript catalog
